name: SWAYAM (Free Online Courses)
description: National MOOC platform offering free online courses from school to postgraduate level with certificates.
eligibility: Open to all learners; some courses have eligibility for credit/ exam.
benefits: Free quality courses, certificates (with exam fee), academic credit transfer where recognised.
application_steps: Take proctored exam (optional, paid) for certificate.
fees: Course free; certificate exam fee applicable.
validity: Course completions archived; certificates issued per cycle.

faq.a: Courses are free; a fee applies only for the proctored certificate exam.

ai_summary: SWAYAM offers free government online courses from school to PG, with paid certificates.
ai_explanation: SWAYAM is India's national MOOC platform providing free courses designed by top institutions. Learners enrol, complete lectures and assignments, and can earn a certificate by paying a proctored exam fee. Credits may transfer where recognised.
common_questions: How do I get a SWAYAM certificate?
suggested_followups: How do I take the SWAYAM exam?
